name: Automatic GitHub Actions failure routing through Founder Control Room
acceptanceCriteria: CI invokes the scanner after required jobs do not succeed and uploads the exact-run Control Room report.
Major non-CI workflow failures are captured through a completed-workflow watcher without a manual scan.
The scanner handles exact run IDs, open pull-request failures, and completed failed main-branch push runs with distinct fingerprints.
Runs without executed steps remain infrastructure evidence while runs with executed failing steps remain code or configuration evidence.
Credentials and private product content are excluded from reports, issue metadata, workflow artifacts, and client bundles.

verification.blocker: Exact-head tests and GitHub Actions jobs must execute and pass, followed by controlled pull-request and main-branch failure report rehearsals.
